_about: Source-credibility flags for Scarecrow Watch signals. 'state' outlets are state-owned or state-affiliated media: they are NOT removed — they are flagged so analysts weigh them with caution, and because state-media incitement or dehumanization is itself a PREVENT risk indicator worth seeing. 'deny' outlets are pure spam / content farms and are removed from the feed; it starts empty so nothing is dropped until a name is curated in. Matching is case-insensitive and whole-word against the outlet name only (the signal's 'source' field), so keep entries specific to avoid false positives.
_maintainers: Add an outlet by putting its publisher name (as it appears in the 'source' field of a signal) into the right list. Prefer the full, specific name over short acronyms.
